title: Understanding the Models
text: Model A includes height in inches $$h_{in}$$, height in centimeters $$h_{cm}$$, weight in pounds $$w_{lb}$$, and weight in kilograms $$w_{kg}$$. Model B includes only height in centimeters $$h_{cm}$$ and weight in kilograms $$w_{kg}$$.

title: Confidence Intervals and Zero
text: A confidence interval that includes zero suggests that the parameter might not be significantly different from zero. Consider the variables included in each model and their potential impact on the prediction.
